scenes.text: Your roommate snores like a chainsaw.
So you shove a pillow in his face.
Okay. If he wants to be a chainsaw, he can work like one.
You feed him a log. Out comes a chair.
Hold on. That's a really nice chair.
So you feed him a whole tree. A table. A bookshelf. A full bedroom set.
You open a furniture store. It blows up. Everybody on Earth wants one.
Eight billion orders. One employee. And he's asleep. Perfect.
Then one morning, he wakes up. Well rested. For the first time in years.
So now it's three A M, and you're singing him a lullaby, begging him to snore like a chainsaw.
